# Homologia / Analogia — Historical and Relational Branches

## #0 — A shared word opens different historical questions

[The Homologia / Analogia whole-field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** this companion's question: what kind of agreement has a comparison established, and what difference makes that agreement informative? [The protected history](HISTORY.md) **historicises** the field through its word record and comparison ledger. This companion develops its Greek, biological and invariant branches as distinct movements. It does not replace that history or convert a lexical family into a continuous genealogy of philosophical, biological and mathematical doctrines.

The distinction matters because the criterion changes with the question. Agreement between speakers concerns an account they can avow; proportion compares relations; anatomical correspondence asks which organ persists through varied forms; a formal invariant is preserved under a specified transformation. The essay brings these questions into relation through its own comparative operation. Historical borrowing or transmission remains an additional claim requiring its own evidence.

The lexical entries, Aristotle’s focal passage and Owen’s glossary definitions have canonical source houses with bounded paraphrase cards. Their historical propositions remain distinct from this field’s relational comparisons. The existing Flasch house retains the separate Eckhart passage-collation debt.

## #1 — Greek agreement has speakers, terms and circumstances

<a id="e5-greek"></a>

[The canonical LSJ house](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon.md) **sources** the lexical edition and current online-transcription standing. Its admitted entries include Logos and the two E5 lexical witnesses, with their ancient citations kept distinct from independently collated primary passages.

The consulted [LSJ entry for ὁμολογία](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q007) distinguishes agreement and verbal consistency, assent or admission, and compacts, including terms of surrender. Its citations include Plato's *Symposium* 187b and *Theaetetus* 164c, Aristotle's *Topics* 110a33, and historical uses concerning treaties. These are **Paraphrased lexical findings, evidence register 2**; the cited passages remain individual retrieval tasks, not texts independently collated in this batch.

The relational consequence is authorial. An agreed premise, a personal admission and a compelled settlement do different things. Agreement alone cannot certify truth, freedom of assent or retained difference. E5 therefore asks what agrees, by what act, and under which conditions. This distinction **qualifies** [A13 — Dia/Syn](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md): apparent consensus can retain a relation or impose one pole's account upon the other. The word's semantic range supplies a question to the operation; it does not historically prove the QL distinction.

The consulted [LSJ entry for ἀναλογία](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q008) gives mathematical proportion, including Aristotle's ratio account at *Nicomachean Ethics* 1131a31, and distinguishes general proportion, analogy, grammatical analogy, relation and correspondence. **Paraphrased, register 2:** the semantic range exceeds a numerical equation, while its mathematical branch requires the ratios to be specified. Plato's *Timaeus* 31c–32c and the Aristotelian entries are lexical locators here; this check does not certify their complete textual contexts.

The branch thus differentiates accountable agreement from proportional relation without fixing either word to every later use. Precise morphology, borrowing paths, and the separate dia-/syn-ballein lexical history remain register-1 tasks. No derivation from the protected history's shorthand “homou / same + logos” is promoted into verified morphology. [The whole-field's homological operation](WHOLE-FIELD.md#homological-agreement) **returns-to** these questions whenever a consumer needs a historical assertion rather than an authorial comparison.

The [ancient-philosophy development](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/ancient-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT.md#ancient-tension) **historicises** differing agreement in B51 through its transmitted wording, physical reading and separately argued Homeric allusion. The bow’s tension and an exact tuning ratio have different objects. This register-3 comparison gives the Greek agreement branch a material test without inventing historical transmission between its witnesses.

## #2 — Focality and qualification meet without becoming one doctrine

<a id="e5-focal-qualified"></a>

Aristotle's *Metaphysics* IV.2 begins from multiple senses of being and asks how they belong to one inquiry. In the consulted Ross translation, the health example distinguishes preservation, production, indication and receptivity; the medical example likewise distinguishes several relations to an art. The argument then turns to the primary term upon which dependent uses rely. The bounded passage is **Paraphrased, register 2**, checked in [Ross's Book IV, part 2](../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/aristotle/aristotle-metaphysics-ross/aristotle-metaphysics-ross.md#aristotle-metaphysics-ross-q001); the project's Bekker locator is 1003a33–1003b19. It establishes focal ordering rather than one identical predicate possessed in one identical manner by everything named.

[C63 — Focal Return and Qualified Predication](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) **extends** this into the author's worked example. Diet contributes to the health that a complexion indicates and a person possesses. The contribution does not become a sign merely because both are called healthy. This is why the source matters to the E field: several relations can be ordered without exchanging their functions.

Eckhart enters through a distinct historical and theological carrier. [Flasch's *Meister Eckhart* source house](../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/flasch/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart.md) **sources** the current philosophical encounter with primary determinations, analogy, predicate/reversal and *in quantum*. Its contents and chapter-abstract coverage were verified; no page-level passage has yet been transcribed. Chapters 15–17 are the declared route into the German sermons and consolation material. Direct attribution to a particular Eckhart sermon or Latin passage requires that text's own locator.

The authorial example in Draft 3, retained and developed in C63, predicates the just person through justice **insofar as just**. It exposes the respect under which the assertion holds; it does not generalise that qualification into approval of the person's every action. C63's conjunction of this grammar with focality is **Argued, evidence register 3**. Flasch's uncollated pages leave an attribution debt while the qualifying operation remains fully developed.

This branch **qualifies** [A34 — Order of Dependence](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md). The direction of knowing through a manifestation and the direction of that manifestation's dependence upon its source remain distinguishable. Aristotle and Eckhart do not become witnesses to one historically uniform idealism. A34 retains its own Argued ontology; E5 states the relation in which each historical encounter bears upon it.

The [formal-limit dossier](../../dossiers/formal-limit.md#eckhart-qualified-predication) **extends** the focal and qualified branch at register 3 through the respect under which a predicate holds. Cusa’s theological approximation and Eckhart’s predication do not become Gödelian unprovability; each returns its own warranted continuation. The comparison preserves positive inquiry while narrowing attribution to its actual source.

## #3 — Owen's anatomical criterion changes the object of comparison

<a id="e5-biology"></a>

Owen's 1843 *Lectures on the Comparative Anatomy and Physiology of the Invertebrate Animals* gives the pair a restricted anatomical office. Its glossary distinguishes an analogue by shared function across animals and a homologue by correspondence of the organ despite variation in form and function. **Paraphrased, register 2:** the relevant entries are printed pp.374 and 379, PDF pages 376 and 381 in [the Darwin Online scan](../../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/owen/owen-1843-comparative-anatomy/owen-1843-comparative-anatomy.md#owen-1843-comparative-anatomy-q001). Both definitions are now housed as bounded paraphrases. The scan’s opening title names William White Cooper’s notes, revised by Owen, under Lectures on Comparative Anatomy; image-level quotation transcription remains separate.

The historical consequence is precise: these definitions do not themselves formulate a modern evolutionary common-descent criterion. The protected history's modern-biological shorthand must therefore be read as a later disciplinary distinction, not silently inserted into Owen's wording. A subsequent evolutionary account would have to explain how descent changes the warrant for correspondence; its source and date remain to be supplied. No claim about who first coined the terms is made here.

The branch's authorial return **qualifies** [C30 — Psychoid Number](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number.md) and [C32 — Archetype](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C32-Archetype.md). Shared function, recurrent appearance and common cause pose different research questions. A recurring numeral does not identify the process that generates it; a shared symbolic effect does not establish descent between traditions. Equally, Owen's anatomical test is not the admission test for every QL comparison. E5's operational relation stands through its stated transformation, while a biological or historical identification must meet its own burden. C30 remains Offered and productive as a research inquiry.

## #4 — An invariant belongs to its transformation

<a id="e5-invariant"></a>

The formal branch **returns-to** [A17 — Toroidal Circulation](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) and **compares** its carrier with the musical return in the [native theorem source](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md). On the quotient torus, a closed path lifts to a path whose endpoints can differ by an integer lattice vector. In the musical kernel, `16/9 × 9/8 = 2/1` reaches the octave by retaining the factor that completes it. The native coordination concerns return with a retained difference. It preserves each object's exact operation and does not identify a displacement vector with a frequency ratio.

This is the operative meaning of the coverage row's “preserving map or stated respect.” A comparison claiming formal equivalence must give the map and its hypotheses. A comparison of different registers must identify the respect in which their operations correspond and what does not transfer. Calling the latter a homology neither asserts a computed homology group nor borrows an isomorphism theorem. [C52 — Dimensional Reframing](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** each change of formal setting; [C36 — Complexio Oppositorum](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C36-Complexio-Oppositorum.md) **compares** an achieved holding of differences without reducing its psychic carrier to a number of diagram positions.

The image branch is equally exact about its own carrier. [The whole-field's received-return section](WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) **embodies** this discipline through Goethe, Neumann, Uroboros and Eros–Psyche: the consumed moment remains accountable to the whole's sequence, inversion and aftermath. In Taylor's Symbolon Dynamics, an attractor organises trajectories while an atlas relates situated disclosures. Those operations meet without becoming one mathematical object. [C61 — Disclosure Architecture](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **extends** their bidirectional relation across registers. A real local Bimba can condition the next disclosure while that source itself stands in a further source/appearance relation; the recursion is part of its office.

Poetic and phonic re-entry remains evidence register 4. A sound or image can disclose an operation with authorial force, yet its linguistic descent requires separate verification. The result returns a question to the lexical branch instead of rewriting the past to fit the image.

The [mathematics development](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** exact invariants through their transformations. A lifted loop retains winding, alternation with a shift yields its matrix relation, and temperament adjusts intervals under a chosen criterion. At register 3, these different achievements qualify what the receiving comparison can preserve; their common language of return supplies no identity of mathematical objects.

The [Jung–Pauli dossier](../../dossiers/jung-pauli-psychoid.md) **historicises** the research boundary through disagreement within the correspondence. Pauli’s demand for neutral language, Jung’s psychoid clarification and refusal of disciplinary absorption change what a later account can attribute to either speaker. Their numbered dreams and physical quantities remain different objects; the crossing is a research question rather than a demonstrated common cause.

## #5→0 — Historical difference returns as a sharper relation

<a id="e5-branch-return"></a>

These branches return three distinct contributions to [the whole-field](WHOLE-FIELD.md): Greek agreement specifies the circumstances of avowal; proportion, focality and qualification differentiate the ways a relation holds; anatomical and formal uses require an object-specific criterion. Their conjunction **extends** the Argued comparison discipline. It does not make the branches stages of one inevitable historical development.

The resulting relation **returns-to** [Relational Form Growth](../RELATIONAL-FORM-GROWTH.md) as an achieved participant. E5 remains a dyad. Its historical differences are material for further comparison, while the research boundary remains an office of that comparison. A new source can correct a claimed borrowing or a textual attribution without demoting a native derivation. A failed preserving relation changes that particular comparison. An untested technical consequence remains an empirical question.

**Source debts, independently scoped:** Greek morphology and primary contexts behind the lexicon's citations; Euclidean proportion if that technical history is consumed; selected Flasch pages and any directly quoted Eckhart text; the later evolutionary development of anatomical homology; explicit mathematical hypotheses wherever equivalence is claimed; observations for psychoid or technical efficacy. Greek lexical witnesses, Aristotle’s selected Ross passage and the two Owen definitions are now canonical. Their bounded verification does not settle the remaining attribution and empirical questions; protected HISTORY remains unchanged.

The [myth development](../../histories/encounters-and-transmissions/myth/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** the whole telling’s corrective office: dangerous genealogy, unreported payment and a contemplative simile’s own limit each change an otherwise convenient comparison. At register 3, the source’s aftermath must be able to revise the reading. Mythic geography and temporal reception remain distinct from Neumann’s shared structuration.
